en: Illustrated landscape view of a green hilly valley with scattered houses and a prominent baroque church complex with twin towers and a dome on the right side. Snow‑capped mountains appear in the background under a pastel sky at either sunrise or sunset. The scene looks down toward a larger town in the distance. Printed text at the top left reads "MARIATROST bei Graz," and there is cursive handwriting across the upper center of the card.
